sections.title: What Tragram does
sections.lead: Tragram helps you monitor selected Telegram channels and route parsed trade instructions into your connected MT4/MT5 workflow.
bullets: You choose which Telegram channels to connect and which MT accounts may receive instructions.
You configure execution settings, symbols, sizing, take-profit behavior, stop-loss rules, execution controls, and other account-level safeguards available in the platform.
Tragram may parse messages with rule-based and AI-assisted systems. You remain responsible for reviewing configuration and deciding whether automation is appropriate for your trading setup.
Tragram does not create independent trading advice, guarantee signal quality, guarantee parser accuracy, or guarantee any trading result.

sections.title: Trading risk and user responsibility
body: Trading foreign exchange, CFDs, commodities, indices, crypto assets, and other leveraged products can result in substantial losses. Automated execution can increase the speed and volume of trading errors if your settings, broker environment, signal format, or market conditions are not suitable.

You are responsible for your broker account, Telegram access, selected channels, parser settings, symbol mapping, trade sizing, risk limits, execution rules, and any order sent to your trading platform. You should test configurations carefully before enabling live execution.

sections.title: Who is responsible for your data
body: Tragram F.Z.C is the controller of personal data processed through Tragram, unless a specific feature or contract says otherwise. Our registered address is B.C. 6010546, Ajman Boulevard-A Building, Ajman Free Zone, Ajman, United Arab Emirates.

If you use Tragram for an organization, both the organization and the individual account users may have privacy responsibilities depending on how the organization configures Telegram channels and trading accounts.

sections.title: Data we collect
bullets: Account data such as name, email, phone number, language, country, authentication events, and account settings.
Telegram connection data such as linked session metadata, selected channels, message identifiers, parsed signal text, parser outputs, and skip or diagnostic reasons.
Trading workflow data such as connected MT account metadata, symbols, order requests, execution status, trade history, risk settings, take-profit and stop-loss settings, logs, and audit events.
Billing and subscription data such as plan, invoices, payment provider references, refund requests, payment status, and fraud-prevention metadata.
Technical data such as device/browser information, IP address, cookies or similar identifiers, session tokens, API logs, error logs, notification tokens, and security events.
Support and communication data such as contact requests, messages, support history, notification preferences, and related attachments or screenshots you provide.

sections.title: How we use data
body: We use personal data to authenticate users, connect Telegram and MT workflows, parse signal messages, execute the settings you choose, display account and trade status, process subscriptions, handle refunds, deliver notifications, provide support, prevent abuse, improve reliability, and comply with legal or payment obligations.

Where AI-assisted parsing is enabled or required to interpret a signal, message content and related context may be processed by AI systems to extract possible symbol, direction, entry, stop-loss, and take-profit information. AI output can be wrong, incomplete, or affected by the source message format.

sections.title: Legal bases and legitimate interests
body: Depending on your location and the feature used, we process data to perform our contract with you, comply with legal obligations, protect legitimate interests such as security and fraud prevention, respond to your consent where required, or protect vital platform integrity.
You can withdraw optional consent where a feature depends on consent, but this may disable the related functionality.

sections.title: Processors and third-party services
body: We share data with service providers only where needed to operate Tragram. These may include hosting and infrastructure providers, database and logging providers, payment processors, email/SMS/push notification providers, analytics and security tools, AI processing providers, Telegram-related integrations, MT/broker connectivity components, and professional advisers.

Payment details are handled by the payment provider shown at checkout. Tragram does not need full card data to provide subscription status. Third-party platforms such as Telegram, MetaTrader, and your broker process data under their own terms and privacy notices.

sections.title: Retention schedule
sections.lead: Our standard retention period for operational records is 90 days unless the data is still needed for the purposes below.
bullets: Account and subscription data is retained while your account or subscription is active and for the period needed for tax, accounting, legal, billing, dispute, refund, chargeback, fraud-prevention, and compliance obligations.
Telegram skip diagnostics are normally retained for up to 14 days, and read notification records are normally cleaned after 30 days.
Refresh sessions normally expire after 30 days. Database backups are normally retained for up to 14 days.
Aggregated administrative analytics may be retained for up to 180 days where needed for operational reporting.

When you delete your account, Tragram can process the deletion immediately or after a 7-day grace period. Direct identifiers are anonymized and active credentials, sessions, and connected account access are removed, while limited records may remain where necessary for legal, security, fraud-prevention, payment, dispute, or operational reasons.

sections.title: Security
body: We use administrative, technical, and organizational measures designed to protect personal data, including access controls, encryption in transit, credential protection, logging, and monitoring. No online service can guarantee absolute security.
You must keep your Tragram, Telegram, email, phone, MT, and broker credentials secure. Notify us promptly if you believe your account or connected workflow has been compromised.

sections.title: International processing and restricted countries
body: Tragram is operated from the United Arab Emirates and may use service providers in other countries. Where required, we use contractual and operational safeguards for international transfers.

Tragram is not available in Iran, Russia, Belarus, Myanmar, or North Korea. We may use account, payment, IP, device, and country signals to enforce restricted-country rules and other compliance controls.

sections.title: Your privacy choices and rights
body: Depending on your location, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, restrict, object to, or receive a copy of your personal data. You may also request account deletion, unsubscribe from marketing messages, or contact us about privacy questions.

We may need to verify your identity before acting on a privacy request. Some requests may be limited where we must keep records for legal, tax, accounting, security, fraud-prevention, payment, or dispute reasons.

sections.title: Policy updates

refundPage.title: Refund Policy
refundPage.description: This policy explains when subscriptions may be refunded and how to request a review.
refundPage.notice: The standard refund right applies only to your first successful paid subscription purchase. It does not apply to later renewals or additional purchases unless required by law or accepted by Tragram under this policy.

sections.title: Eligibility
body: You may request a refund within 14 calendar days after your first successful paid Tragram subscription purchase. The request must relate to the first paid subscription purchase made through Tragram or its supported checkout provider.

A first paid subscription purchase means the first time your account successfully pays for a Tragram subscription. The refund window starts when the payment succeeds, not when you first use the service.

sections.title: What is not refundable
bullets: Renewals after the first paid subscription purchase.
Second or later purchases, account reactivations, upgrades, add-ons, or plan changes, except where mandatory law requires a refund.
Trading losses, missed trades, signal provider performance, broker execution, slippage, spreads, liquidity, platform outages outside Tragram's control, or configuration choices.
Payments connected to misuse, restricted-country access, fraud, chargeback abuse, or breach of the Terms of Service.

sections.title: Exceptions we may review
body: Even outside the standard first-purchase rule, we may review duplicate charges, clear billing errors, payment provider mistakes, or a material Tragram platform failure that prevented access to paid functionality during the paid period.
Approval is discretionary unless applicable law requires a specific outcome.

sections.title: How to request a refund
body: Contact support within the refund window and include your Tragram account email or phone number, invoice or payment reference, purchase date, plan name, and a short explanation of the issue.
We may ask for additional information to verify the payment, confirm account ownership, investigate misuse, or evaluate the request.

sections.title: Processing and access after approval
body: Approved refunds are returned through the original payment method where possible. Timing depends on the payment provider, payment network, bank, and currency route.
When a refund is approved, Tragram may cancel, downgrade, or disable the paid subscription and related paid features from the refund approval date.

sections.title: Cancellations
body: Canceling a subscription stops future renewals according to the plan terms, but it does not automatically refund past charges unless the charge qualifies under this policy.

sections.title: Mandatory consumer rights
body: Nothing in this policy limits non-waivable refund or consumer rights that apply under mandatory law. Where a conflict exists, mandatory law controls.

refundPage.contactBody: Send the payment reference and account details through the contact page so support can check the request against this policy.
